generation_parents.algorithm: Reuse the round-1 savings-based selection but replace the argmax-with-tie-break step with a single composite score that blends Clarke-Wright savings, a nearest-neighbor term, and a capacity-fill incentive, then pick the highest-scoring feasible customer.

declared_hypothesis: A focused revision may improve measured distance.
